title: Motorcycles & Powersports Hour-of-Day Activity Heatmap
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rever:ride
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day most motorcycles events typically arrive.
value: Hour-of-day patterns expose automation schedules, commute windows, and habits that are easy to miss in daily totals alone.
implementation: Ingest `rever:ride` with accurate `_time` values and chart hourly counts to see when the feed is naturally busy or quiet.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of event count by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your motorcycles data is usually busiest so you can spot routines that moved or feeds that went quiet at the wrong hour.
